title: Manage the balance allocation of Business Centers
content_data:
This article walks you through the steps to manage the balance allocation of Business Centers that have enabled Balance Sharing. # Introduction Balance Sharing, also known as automatic balance allocation, allows for automatic allocation of campaign costs from a shared credit balance among ad accounts owned by the Business Center. # Prerequisites - You've gained access to TikTok API for Business. See [Get Started - Step by step workflow](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1781888800300034) for details. - To manage the balance allocation of Business Centers, you need relevant permissions. See [API Reference](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713875563521) to find out permissions required for endpoints (including the endpoints listed in the **"Steps"** section) and see [App permissions](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738855280338946) to find out how to configure permissions. - Ensure that your Business Center has enabled Monthly Invoicing and Balance Sharing. To learn more about the steps, see [About Balance Sharing in Business Center-How to use Balance Sharing in Business Center](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/about-the-auto-allocate-balance-in-business-center?lang=en) and [Monthly Invoicing](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/credit-line?lang=en). **Once a Business Center has enabled Balance Sharing, the Business Center can NOT switch back to manual allocation mode anymore.** # Important notes - The budget mode and budget amount of each ad account can be updated **up to 10 times a calendar day**. - The minimum value for `budget` is 0. Setting a negative value is not allowed and will result in an error. There is currently no limit to the maximum value. - When you update your budget amount, certain restrictions will be applied to the value of `budget`, depending on whether you change the budget mode. ```xtable |Change status of budget mode{30%}|Restrictions on budget amount{70%}| |---|---|---| |Stay in the same budget mode|`budget` should be no less than 105% of the cumulative spending of the budget mode.| |Switch budget mode|
  • Switch to `MONTHLY_BUDGET`:`budget` should be no less than 105% of the spending of this month.
  • Switch to `DAILY_BUDGET`:`budget` should be no less than 105% of the spending of this day.
  • Switch to `CUSTOM_BUDGET`:`budget` should be no less than 105% of the spending of either the current day or the previous day, depending on which day has actual consumption.
| ``` - You can update the budget of up to 50 accounts at a time. Duplicate `advertiser_id` are not allowed in a single operation. # Steps ## Check the budget limit of a Balance Sharing ad account To check the budget limit of an account within a Business Center with Balance Sharing enabled, use [/advertiser/balance/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739939106470913). In the response, obtain the budget limit through `budget_mode` and `budget`. - If a monthly/daily/custom budget has been set for the ad account, `budget_mode` will be `MONTHLY_BUDGET`/`DAILY_BUDGET`/`CUSTOM_BUDGET` and `budget` will indicate the pre-set monthly/daily/one-time budget limit. Additionally, `budget_cost` will display the actual budget that the ad account has consumed. - If no monthly/daily/custom budget has been set for the ad account, the ad account will use the default unlimited budget. `budget_mode` will be `UNLIMITED` and both `budget` and `budget_cost` will be 0. ## Customize the budget of a Balance Sharing ad account To edit the budget mode of an ad account within a Business Center with Balance Sharing enabled, use [/advertiser/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739939050770434). Pass `bc_id` and the object array `advertiser_budgets`. Within the `advertiser_budgets` array, specify the ad account through `advertiser_id`, set `budget_mode` to `MONTHLY_BUDGET`/`DAILY_BUDGET`/`CUSTOM_BUDGET`, and set `budget` to the new monthly/daily/one-time budget. ## Manage the budget mode of a Balance Sharing ad account To manage the budget mode of an ad account within a Business Center with Balance Sharing enabled, use [/advertiser/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739939050770434). Pass `bc_id` and the object array `advertiser_budgets`. Then set `advertiser_budgets` based on the new budget mode you want to enable for the ad account: - To change the budget mode from customized budget to unlimited budget: - Specify the ad account through `advertiser_id` . - Set `budget_mode` to `UNLIMITED`. - To change the budget mode from unlimited budget to customized budget: - Follow the same steps outlined in Customize the budget of a Balance Sharing ad account. ## Manage the credit balance of a Business Center To increase or decrease the credit balance of a Business Center, use [/bc/transfer/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739939095321601). Configure the following settings: - Pass `bc_id`. - Set `transfer_level` to `BC`. - Set `transfer_type` to `RECHARGE` or `REFUND`. - Set `cash_amount` to the amount that you want to add to or deduct from the credit balance of Business Center.
